summary: New installations no longer fail at the database sign-in, and script commands are simpler to copy.

fixes.title: New tenant installs no longer fail
fixes.text: The installer no longer fails with Login failed at the database step in a new tenant. A refused sign-in is retried for about two minutes.

fixes.title: Script commands are two lines
fixes.text: Every command PIM Manager shows for a published script is now two lines: download the file, run it. The "What does this script do?" link sits next to it.

fixes.title: Install check suggests portal steps
fixes.text: Every fix the install check suggests is an Azure portal step or a published script, never an Azure command line.
